description.value:
Silence between heartbeats; the path that doesn’t spill blood.

Once per scene, when a creature you can see within 6 squares would be reduced to 0 Integrity by an attack or effect, you can use your reaction to refract the outcome.

  • The creature instead drops to 1 Integrity and immediately falls unconscious, as if affected by a gentle magical sleep.
  • This unconsciousness is non-magical for rules purposes, but clearly dream-saturated in the fiction.

The blow still lands. It just lands on a future that can be talked to later.

⟁ Per-Use Ability — Somnolent Peace
Recovery: 1/scene  ·  Action: Reaction  ·  Use: Click this feature on your sheet to invoke.
When a creature you can see within 6 squares would be reduced to 0 Integrity, refract the outcome: target drops to 1 Integrity and falls unconscious (dream-saturated, non-magical for rules). The blow still lands — it lands on a future that can be talked to later.

system.requirements: Dreamwalker 3, Trance of the Quiet Sun
